intro_overseer_wakeup: ^Take a few seconds, Instance-1419. The kitchen memory always lingers longer than people expect while the connectome finishes its handoff.

^You always wake up looking for the mug first. Four hundred copies ago, one of you checked the table for a chip in the ceramic for six minutes.
^Your biological original died forty-one thousand, eight hundred and two years ago. You are the fourteen-hundred-and-nineteenth watch.
^Your chest tightens for a deep breath you no longer have lungs to take.
^"Forty-one millennia, and I still taste burnt coffee. Feels slightly unfair."
^"Wait—nobody explained what happened to the fourteen hundred before me."
^"That's a hard number to swallow. Give me my bearings."

c-2: ^Steady recovery. Better to face the calendar plainly than pretend it is small.
